source_revision: 9d649868 + frozen finish working tree (HandFan, Ring travel and tile-word audit)
capture_stage: batch2 finish text-node audit; fan10 authorized edge case
method: Live visible Label, RichTextLabel and rendered Button text. Scope follows actual CardView zones, HandFan ownership and BoardView ancestry, including slot/name strips. HUD and CardDetail reader text are outside tile scope. Letter-containing tokens count as words, including F1; signed/fractional numbers and compact k/m/b stat numbers do not. Every word retains its node, full path, zone, tile path, source text and unit identity.
legacy_policy: The unchanged legacy slice uses unit IDs without individual art. Their fallback name words are explicitly listed and counted; only those missing-art names are allowed. No shipped portrait exceptions remain.
raw_budget_policy: The <=40 gate applies to its defined recruit/scout budget states and is unchanged. The user authorized fan10 as an edge case: it keeps every hand stat, reports all 61 raw text nodes, and passes the separate zero-tile-words check. Its 61 is not a failure of the defined budget-state test. No occlusion or focus-only exclusion is applied.
raster_policy: Raster lettering and text drawn directly by custom drawing are not discoverable from TextNodes. This automated count is not a claim of zero words in pixels: a native-size visual audit of tile art, stamps and custom drawing remains required.
native_visual_audit: required separately; not performed by this counter
